question:
In a certain code language, ‘RIVAL’ is coded as ‘PKTCJ’ and ‘TEXTS’ is coded as ‘RGVVQ’. How will ‘POINT’ be coded in the

given language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘RIVAL’ is coded as ‘PKTCJ’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf33d5d044fbd9b3237763a95158ad507b9e4b5241597fa5d0e6bb3c0bee005c.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c13e5a4bf772f040fa5a127520787173e1e6a963d010dac746a19560294b1dd.png] 

And,

‘TEXTS’ is coded as ‘RGVVQ’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2480617a2e5c095c2024b07e8c99000e36e3933e8069b981e60478740ef9fe2.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eaf21877084a3a3ca7e38519c0aa11919dfeda7a77c5e532b6dc2201becbf315.png] 

Similarly,

‘POINT’ is coded as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6bb35bef3e5818579fc7ec31e0602c45ec6e4e14fb81f08e494e0c7908a0dd4.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6f0106d770bdefeb8167a2ae79ac8edb62dcf161c776a2c1c4b3ca0b0453349.png] 

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
